Scope: Sam approved the AR first phase on 2026-11-19 (「批准，含作廢收款」 and 「確認」, relayed by the PM). The author (claude-erp-app-ar-01) does not approve this receipt. purpose: AR first phase, PR 3 of 3: invoices from shipped shipments (draft, confirm, cancel, void), invoice list and detail, and the invoiced-shipments lookup. Proves on real MySQL that line amounts follow the approved remaining-pool rule in shipment order through Fulfillment's readInvoiceSourcesInTransaction, that a shipment line sits on one active invoice at a time and can be invoiced again after cancel or void, that a void needs a reason and no active allocation, that the due date follows the payment term unless changed with a reason, that dates cannot be in the future, and that invoice permissions do not inherit. FR-INV-008 checks the latest source shipment date when creating a draft and before confirmation and numbering. An older draft remains unchanged and can be cancelled; an invoice on the latest shipment date can be confirmed. A draft without any shipment source cannot be confirmed or numbered and can still be cancelled.
data: arInvoiceFromShipments: 2 cases, each in its own isolated database built by the existing unchanged Fulfillment fixture shipmentDraftFixture (pinned by fulfillment-task036-event-recovery-functional.json): 1 sales order with 1 line of 5 units and at most 2 shipments; at most 6 invoices and 2 receipts per case. arInvoices: 3 cases using the AR HTTP fixture (pinned by ar-receipts-allocation-aging.json). The confirmation case uses one isolated fixture with one five-unit order line and two real shipments (three and two units). It creates the two valid drafts over HTTP and reuses the existing drafts without sources for rejection and cancellation. The permission case uses a separate isolated fixture with one five-unit order line, one real shipment and one real draft. About 15 invoice rows, one receipt and no concurrency in total. arInvoiceAmount: 2 unit cases with inline values. FR-INV-008 uses different dates on the same two shipments and one additional draft in the first case, backdated in MySQL to simulate a legacy row. Both cases stay within the listed limits.
concurrency: Serial, except two places in one case that each send 2 concurrent commands on a 2-connection pool: two drafts for the same shipment (one succeeds) and two receipts (both succeed).
thresholds: All cases pass; exact equality on amounts, statuses, versions and numbers; coverage floors unchanged; no timing threshold.
trigger: Existing ci.yml triggers and discovery only: the existing server MySQL integration shards and server test job. No new job, schedule or dispatch. No capacity or performance workload.
cost: FR-INV-008 local MySQL run: sum of test case durations about 3.1 s for arInvoiceFromShipments and 6.1 s for arInvoices, including two isolated HTTP databases. The unit cases take under 0.1 s. CI time not measured. No new job.
